effect:
Boosts friendship gain when held. (Hold)

Speeds up friendship gain. Essential for evolving Eevee into Espeon/Umbreon...Togepi into Togetic, baby Pokemon, etc.

Once its evolved just pass the bell to whatever needs friendship next. Saves a lot of time.
